biography.value: The Rift Warden is described in summoning records as something that has existed between planes long enough that the plane it came from has become secondary to what it has become. Its Partial Discontinuity means it absorbs roughly 25% fewer hits than its HP would suggest — ### Attacks that land occasionally strike portions of it that are not, in that moment, present. Spatial Dominion locks down a 60-foot zone in ways that disadvantage every conventional fighting approach simultaneously. Eye Rays on recharge hits every target in a cone with different effects, meaning the outcome of its activation depends on what the specific targets roll. The Enhanced Signal damages and drains every non-Aberration creature within 60 feet per round, which means positioning allies is a significant tactical concern when a Rift Warden is on the field. A summoner who calls one should prepare for a battlefield that has fundamentally changed in spatial terms — the rules that normally govern movement, range, and tactical positioning are operating differently in its presence.

system.sensesNotes: Darkvision unlimited, Seam Sense unlimited, See Invisibility, Perfect Sight 120 ft
system.attacksNotes:
Rift Eye [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 6 + Ranged Combat 7), Range: 150 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 18 force damage (12 + 6 Dex); target loses 4 Current Luck; target makes Will [Easy] save or Confused for 1 minute; target's DR reduced by 3 for 1 minute.
  • Margin 2: 18 force damage, DR halved (round up); Current Luck reduced by 6; target makes Will [Hard] save or Confused for 1 minute; DR reduced by 4; target makes Reflex [Easy] save or loses their [Reaction] until the end of their next turn.
  • Margin 3: 18 force damage, DR halved (round up); Current Luck reduced by 8; target makes Will [Hard] save or Confused for 1 minute; DR reduced by 5; target makes Reflex [Hard] save or loses their [Reaction] until the end of their next turn.

Eye Rays (Recharge 5-8) [Combat]: The Rift Warden fires rays from multiple eyes in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the cone is subjected to the effects of one randomly determined eye: (1) Disorientation: Disoriented for 1 minute, no save. (2) Spatial Crush: 24 force damage (Ignore DR). (3) Luck Drain: lose 6 Current Luck. (4) Ability Severance: lose access to one magical ability for 1 hour, Will save (Hard, 2 successes) to resist. (5) Petrification: Fortitude save (1 success) or Slowed for 1 minute (2 actions instead of 3). (6) Spatial Shunt — teleported 1d6 × 20 feet in a random direction, Fortitude save (1 success) to resist.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Partial Discontinuity: The Rift Warden's body exists partially between planes. ### Attacks against it have a 25% chance (roll 6-8 on d8) of passing through a discontinuous portion and dealing no damage. This is determined per hit, after the attack resolves. Area effects are not subject to this. The Signal: Any creature that begins its turn within 60 feet of the Rift Warden must succeed on a Will [Easy] save or take 12 force damage (Ignore DR) and lose 3 from Current Luck. Creatures reduced to 0 Current Luck by this effect fall Unconscious for 1 hour. Spatial Dominion (1/day) [Combat]: As a [Combat] action, the Rift Warden selects a 60-foot diameter for 1 minute. Within this zone: all teleportation is blocked (as Rift Anchor); difficult terrain costs triple movement; all ranged ### Attacks beyond 30 feet add 2 to both attack dice; the Rift Warden's own movement costs are halved. The Rift Warden cannot be moved out of this zone involuntarily while it persists. Antimagic Gaze (1/encounter) [Combat]: As a [Combat] action, fixes its gaze on a single target within 60 feet. That target's magical abilities are suppressed for 1 round; they cannot use weaves, magical abilities, or magical items. No save. At the end of the round, normal function resumes. Resilient Defense (2/day): When the Rift Warden fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
